title: Web Design
description: A project-based course for school leavers who want to design websites for small businesses. Over four weeks you will plan, build, style and publish a mobile-friendly website for a local business, then learn how to sell web design as a service.
outcomes: Plan a website for a local business: goals, pages and content
Build well-structured pages with HTML and style them with CSS
Choose readable colours and fonts and lay out pages with Flexbox
Make sites that work well on phones, load fast and are accessible
Add a contact or order form and publish a site online
Price and sell simple web design services to local clients
